kind.x-source: PT-007 requires a channel-neutral COMMAND and RESULT pair.

notification_id.x-source: DECLARED INFERENCE, previously UNSOURCED. PT-007 requires a command/result pair, which needs an identity linking the two; no cited task names an id field. Independent review found this shipped with no source while ten siblings had one -- the same defect CTR-OBS-001 records as already corrected for its trace_id, three directories away in this catalog.
notification_id.x-bound-note: Bounded 2026-10-07 under open_blockers[13] (C0 N-6; RFC-2026-009 R-4 lists it among the 49 unbounded reference-shaped fields), because A1 measured a 1,000,000-character value ACCEPTED on its siblings (A1-S3). No baseline task states a length limit for any reference (RFC-2026-009 R-2), so THE BOUND IS A DECLARED INFERENCE, taken from RFC-2026-009's values for the same class: 128 for an id, 256 for a `scheme:path` reference. An id: 128, the bound CTR-EVT-001.event_id, CTR-JOB-001.job_id and CTR-API-001.request_id carry. It bounds LENGTH, not content: an id is opaque by design (RFC-2026-009 R-5), so a name or an email address of 128 characters or fewer still validates. A1-S3 measured exactly that; it is recorded under this manifest's untestable_by_schema and a character class for the id is left to A5.

channel.x-source: PT-007 Inputs: 'in-app first; email/LINE future'. Listing the two future channels is a DECLARED INFERENCE -- PT-007 names them as future, so a contract that omitted them would have to change to add them.

message_key.x-source: PT-007 requires locale support, and CTR-ERR-001 establishes a Thai message KEY rather than prose for user-facing text. DECLARED INFERENCE from that precedent.
message_key.x-bound-note: Bounded 2026-10-07 under open_blockers[13] (C0 N-6; RFC-2026-009 R-4 lists it among the 49 unbounded reference-shaped fields), because A1 measured a 1,000,000-character value ACCEPTED on its siblings (A1-S3). No baseline task states a length limit for any reference (RFC-2026-009 R-2), so THE BOUND IS A DECLARED INFERENCE, taken from RFC-2026-009's values for the same class: 128 for an id, 256 for a `scheme:path` reference. A message key is a KEY into a localized message catalog, not a reference, so neither class fits it exactly; it takes 128, the id bound, because it is a dotted identifier that names one catalog entry, and the longest one any fixture uses is 29 characters. The pattern already keeps it to lowercase letters, `_` and `.`, so it cannot carry a contact detail.

locale.x-source: Section 3.1: Phase 1 locale default is th-TH. Only the supported locale is listed, so adding one is a visible contract change.

target_ref.x-bound-note: Bounded 2026-10-07 under open_blockers[13] (C0 N-6; RFC-2026-009 R-4 lists it among the 49 unbounded reference-shaped fields), because A1 measured a 1,000,000-character value ACCEPTED on its siblings (A1-S3). No baseline task states a length limit for any reference (RFC-2026-009 R-2), so THE BOUND IS A DECLARED INFERENCE, taken from RFC-2026-009's values for the same class: 128 for an id, 256 for a `scheme:path` reference. A `scheme:path` reference: 256, the bound on CTR-IDM-001.result_ref, CTR-JOB-001.input_ref/result_ref and CTR-API-001.deep_link_ref, whose grammar this field adopts. 256 is also the length the database enforces on those references (RFC-2026-009 R-2), so a deep link can name anything they can.

deep_link.x-source: PT-007 requires deep-link support, and CTR-NTF-001's own catalog row requires a 'permission-checked deep link'. requires_permission is const true because a deep link that does not demand a permission check is the defect the row names. The target_ref grammar is the catalog reference form adopted from CTR-IDM-001. `requires_permission` is in `required` as well as `const true`, because a const never fires on an ABSENT property: without the requirement the permission check failed open silently. Independent testing found it.

dedupe_key.x-source: ID-005 notification dedupe strategy: a completed or retried event must not notify a user twice beyond policy. PT-007 requires dedupe support.
dedupe_key.x-bound-note: Bounded 2026-10-07 under open_blockers[13] (C0 N-6; RFC-2026-009 R-4 lists it among the 49 unbounded reference-shaped fields), because A1 measured a 1,000,000-character value ACCEPTED on its siblings (A1-S3). No baseline task states a length limit for any reference (RFC-2026-009 R-2), so THE BOUND IS A DECLARED INFERENCE, taken from RFC-2026-009's values for the same class: 128 for an id, 256 for a `scheme:path` reference. A dedupe key: 128, the bound on CTR-JOB-001.dedupe_key, the other dedupe key RFC-2026-009 bounded (R-2: '128 on the ids and dedupe_key'). CTR-USG-001's dedupe_key carries 512 because its composition embeds two ids, a dimension, a basis and an instant; this key has no stated composition to size against, so it takes the class bound.
dedupe_key.x-pii-shape: A1-S3 / SC-3, 2026-10-07. A1 measured this key ACCEPTING an email address and a phone number, and a key sits in a dedupe store for the whole dedupe window, so it must not be able to carry a contact detail. CHARACTER CLASS, enforced by the pattern: the literal namespace `ntf:`, then one or more `:`-separated segments of ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-` (later segments may also hold `.`, so a message-key fragment such as `content.approved` fits). It has no `@`, no `+`, no whitespace and no `/`, so an email address, an E.164 phone number and a spaced name are rejected. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, recorded rather than hidden: a bare run of digits such as a local phone number is still admitted, because the opaque ids a key is built from are themselves digits and letters. The full COMPOSITION -- which ids and which event make up a key -- is ID-005's `dedupe key policy` and is A5's decision; it is NOT stated here, and the manifest's untestable_by_schema records it as owed. DECLARED INFERENCE: the `ntf:` namespace follows CTR-USG-001's `usg:` and the shipped fixtures, which already use `ntf:<source id>:<event>`.

state.x-source: DECLARED INFERENCE. PT-007 names no state machine. `queued`, `delivered` and `failed` are this contract's own terms; `suppressed_duplicate` is inferred from ID-005, which requires a completed or retried event not to notify a user twice beyond policy -- a suppression that is invisible in the result cannot be audited.

delivery.x-source: PT-007 requires a channel-neutral result and CT-007 requires transient and permanent failure to be distinguishable. An earlier version carried `domain_result_rolled_back: const false`. That was a CATEGORY ERROR, found by independent review: it asserted what a DIFFERENT subsystem did, so if a rollback actually occurred the truthful report became schema-invalid -- suppressing the evidence rather than preventing the violation. Decision Register 4.2 already places that prohibition where it belongs: MOD-100's ห้ามทำ column reads 'roll back domain result on delivery failure', on A5's own module. A contract describing one notification cannot enforce it.

tenant_context.x-source: Section 3.1: every command touching customer data carries the Trusted Tenant Context.

allOf.x-rule: PT-007: a channel-neutral COMMAND names its channel, its localized message key and its permission-checked deep link, and carries no delivery state -- that belongs to the result.
CT-007 requires transient and permanent failure to be distinguishable; a failure stating neither is unusable to a retry policy. The rollback flag was removed from this rule -- see delivery.x-source.
A delivered notification cannot carry a failure class. Independent testing found `state: delivered` with `failure_class: permanent` accepted.
